title: Nvidia commits $1B in Nscale pre-IPO convertible notes

sources.quote: The financing consists of an initial $2.36bn tranche at closing and an additional $1bn commitment from NVIDIA with funding expected in mid-November, 2026.

explain: Nvidia committed $1 billion to Nscale through convertible loan notes, a loan that turns into shares when Nscale goes public. The money was expected to arrive in mid-November 2026.
